title: Dashte bala me goonjte the Fatima ke bain
body:
DASHT-E-BALAA MEIN GOONJTE THE FATIMA KE BAIN
BEKAS MERE HUSSAIN – BEKAS MERE HUSSAIN
Jalti huwe zamee’n pe hai Laashe Shahe Zaman
Teghoo’n se choor choor hai Shabbir ka badan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab karbala ki qaak hai mazloom ka kafan
Ghalta hai qaak-o-khoon mein Zehra ka noor-e-ain
Paamaal run mein hogaya laasha Hussain ka
Un zaalimo’n ko rokne wala koi na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum sorahe ho neher pe Abbas-e-Bawafa
Aaye to kaise aaye Dil-e-Fatima ko chain
Ek bezuba’n ka hausla-e-jung haye haye
Sookhe gale par teere sitam khaake muskuraye
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani ke ek sawaal pe jo khoon mein nahaye
Dafna rahe hain laash ko ab Shah-e-Mashraqain
Ibn-e-Hasan ke byaah ka manzar ajeeb tha
Shaadi ke ghar me aik qayamat si thi bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar ko jhukaye baithi thi aik paikare haya
Dil mein lagi thi aag magar kar saki na bain
Zainab ke laal Aun-o-Mohammed nahi rahe
Bekas ghareeb dasht mein kis kiska gham kare
<<DIVIDER>>
Beto’n ka daagh dil pe ye maa kis tarah sahe
Kehti hai bequsoor tha bhai mera Hussain
Akber gaye to Shai ki basaarat chali gayi
Beta jawaan margaya quwwat chali gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Akber ke saath zeest ki lazzat chali gayi
Khaata hai run mein thokare Zehra ka Noor-e-Ain
Jalte huwe qayaam wo sehraye nainawa
Ghash mein pada hai Abid-e-Beemar-e-Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Bistar dehek-ti aag ke sholo’n mein ghir gaya
Saidaniyo’n mein barpa hai har simt shoro shain
Nauha Sohail tumne ye kya khoob hai kaha
Deti rahegi tumko dua Bint-e-Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya door hai mile jo tumhe dil ka muddua
Tumko sahara baqshegi Bint-e-Shah-e-Hunain
